notes:
Summary: Verdigris Press manages a 20+ year back-catalog of mixed-format media (OCRed books, editorial articles, TV/Radio transcripts). Primary ask: replace brittle keyword search with a RAG pipeline (dense retrieval + cross-encoder reranker) tuned for long-document relevance and tight latency budgets.

Scale / corpus: ~1.2M source documents; variable length 500-200k tokens (avg ~6k). After preferred semantic chunking target ~28-35M passages (anchor chunks ~800-1,600 tokens, 25% overlap for context). They estimate ingest growth of ~10%/yr.

Indexing & storage: Interested in batching/quantization guidance to keep vector index size <8TB for Dedicated deployment. Poked at options: Faiss IVF+PQ for coarse quantization + HNSW for fine-search, or Redwood Optimize suggestions. Need retention policy for raw text vs vectors (retain vectors longer).

Latency & throughput targets: Interactive search UI target 200-300ms 95p for retrieval (ANN), end-to-end (retrieve + rerank top-50 cross-encoder) target <=400-500ms 95p. Bulk re-rank jobs (metadata enrichment pipelines) can run asynchronously with higher latency. Cost target: average production cost per interactive query < $0.02 total (embeddings + reranker + infra amortized). Highly cost sensitive.

Chunking strategy discussion (notes from call 2026-02-25):
- Prefer semantic-aware chunks: use sentence-boundaries + N token window (800-1,200 tokens) for editorial content; transcripts use smaller chunks (400-600) because speaker context matters.
- Overlap recommended 20-30% for long narratives to preserve context for reranker.
- Sliding window vs anchor-first: pilot both; anchor-first reduces index size but sliding improves recall for paraphrased queries.
- Keep mapping from chunk->document and store chunk offsets for highlight/clipping.

Retriever + Reranker tuning (engineering notes):
- Retriever: dense embeddings with offline-trained sentence-transformer variant (embedding dimension 1,024) quantized to int8 for storage. Use OPQ + IVF with HNSW on coarse centroids for speed.
- Reranker: candidate cross-encoder style (deberta or small LLaMA-based cross-encoder) evaluated; cross-encoder latency is biggest cost driver. Plan: experiment with 1) small cross-encoder (6-7B quant) on Dedicated GPUs for 50-100 ms per rerank on top-50, 2) distilled cross-encoder (re-ranker student) for lower latency at slight quality drop, 3) cascade reranking: lightweight cheap scorer first (monoBERT-like) then expensive cross-encoder on top-10.
- Metrics to evaluate: MRR@10, nDCG@5, manual editorial relevance score on 500 gold queries, latency 95p, cost/query.

POC plan & milestones:
1) Week 1: ingest 100k representative docs (various lengths), implement chunking scripts, produce 1M chunks.
2) Week 2: build vector index (IVF+OPQ) and run baseline ANN retrieval. Measure recall and latency.
3) Week 3: train/evaluate reranker candidates on seeded relevance labels (editorial team to label 500 queries).
4) Week 4: run full-stack eval with Redwood-hosted Dedicated node vs Private pilot (compare latency/cost). Deliverables: perf report, cost model, suggested batch/quantization profile.

Security & compliance: Verdigris requires SSO + SAML, SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logging of queries, and option to keep everything in customer VPC. Legal insisted on data residency (EU) for certain titles; Redwood Private/VPC recommended.

Quotes from call: "We want search that finds the exact scene in a 90-minute transcript without surfacing ten irrelevant articles. Latency needs to feel instant. And show us the math on cost.", noted Head of Search (A. Lema).

Commercial notes: Prefers Dedicated or Private for predictable throughput; procurement timeline depends on security sign-off and editorial QA metrics. AE notes: pitch includes 12-month committed Dedicated cluster pricing + 2-week on-prem pilot offer. SE follow-ups: provide chunking script examples, sample dedup heuristics, recommended embedding model hyperparams.

Open action items:
- SE (Carlos) to deliver chunking prototype (sliding + anchor) and sample indexed subset by 2026-03-12.
- Schedule security review with infra on 2026-03-10 (result pending).
- Editorial to deliver 500 labeled queries by 2026-03-18.

Stated blockers (from customer): budget cycles close end of Q2; cannot sign until residency clause added.

References / artifacts: pricing deck (drive link), sample query list (drive), security FAQ.

CRM shorthand lines (sales notes):
- "Evaling both Dedicated and Private; strong bias to Private if residency gating."

SE (Carlos) to deliver chunking prototype and sample subset; AE to follow up on procurement timeline.
short_summary: Enterprise RAG POC for large, long-document media archive. Focus: chunking strategy, ANN index sizing, cross-encoder reranker latency vs quality tradeoffs. Enterprise concerns: data residency + cost per query.
